name: Shoe website
description: I created Shoes shopping website wireframe
problem:
Many online shoe shopping websites struggle to balance product visibility with an engaging user experience. Users often encounter cluttered layouts, weak visual hierarchy, and interfaces that fail to immediately draw attention to featured products or ongoing promotions. This can make browsing less interactive and reduce user engagement.

The challenge for this project was to design a visually appealing and modern landing page that effectively highlights featured products while maintaining a clean and easy-to-navigate experience.

Key Problems Identified:
Product information was not visually emphasized enough
Promotional offers lacked strong attention-grabbing placement
Navigation could feel overwhelming or disconnected
Lack of engaging visual hierarchy
Users needed a faster and more immersive browsing experience
Design Goal:

To create a modern Nike-inspired landing page that:

Highlights the featured shoe as the focal point
Creates strong visual hierarchy using typography and spacing
Makes promotions instantly noticeable
Improves navigation clarity
Delivers a premium and interactive shopping experience

My Solution:
Designed a clean and product-focused interface with bold typography, promotional highlights, balanced layout structure, and strong visual emphasis on the product to create a more engaging shopping experience.
process:
Research → Studied ecommerce websites, user needs, and design inspiration.

Problem Definition → Identified issues in product visibility, navigation, and user engagement.

Ideation → Explored layout ideas, content hierarchy, and interface concepts.

Wireframing→ Created low-fidelity structures for screen layout and user flow.
UI Design → Designed visually appealing high-fidelity screens with typography, colors, and branding.

Prototyping→ Built interactive flows to simulate the user experience.

Testing & Iteration → Refined the design to improve usability and overall experience.
